description_from_the_seller_parsed:
Powerful HPE ProLiant DL325 Gen10 Plus 1U rack server is equipped with an AMD EPYC 7302P 16-Core processor, 32 Threads.
- iDRAC has been factory reset.
- iLO has been factory reset.
- BMC has been factory reset.
- PERC has been reset.
- Smart Array has been reset
- Generic Raid Controller has been reset.
- No RAM included
- No HDD included, no caddies.
- Drive Bays: x 3.5" — no blanks, no trays.
- Drive Bays: x 2.5" — no blanks, no trays.
1. Power Efficiency & TDP Dynamics
Single-Socket Advantage: The Z640 relies on a dual-socket Broadwell-EP layout, meaning you are paying an idle power penalty to keep two separate chipsets and multiple memory controllers awake. The DL325 Gen10 is a single-socket (1P) system, delivering massive multi-core throughput while drawing significantly less baseline energy than a dual-CPU workstation under light or mixed loads.
Watts per Core: While EPYC Rome processors (like the 7302P) have higher absolute power ceilings under full multi-threaded stress, their idle and mid-load efficiency heavily outperforms older 2015-era Xeons. Depending on your drives and peripheral cards, a configured EPYC 7002 node idles reasonably efficiently for an enterprise rack server and completely destroys older Xeons on a performance-per-watt basis.
2. Architectural Headroom for Proxmox
PCIe Gen 4.0 Throughput: Unlike the Z640's legacy PCIe Gen 3.0 lanes, the DL325 Gen10 provides full PCIe Gen 4 support. If you pass through modern high-speed NVMe storage drives, high-bandwidth network cards (like 10GbE/25GbE adapters), or accelerators to your Proxmox VMs, you won't run into the bandwidth bottlenecks inherent to the older platform.
Memory Bandwidth & Channels: The EPYC architecture features 8 memory channels per socket (compared to the 4 channels per CPU on the C612 chipset). This means your VMs and containers get vastly superior memory throughput, which is vital when running memory-heavy database workloads, ZFS caching, or multiple busy containers simultaneously.
Modern Instruction Sets (AVX2 / BMI2): The Zen 2 architecture of the EPYC 7302P handles modern instruction sets with much higher IPC (Instructions Per Cycle) than Broadwell Xeons, making single-threaded tasks inside your containers or VMs feel noticeably snappier.
3. Enterprise Management & Form Factor
HPE iLO 5: The DL325 gives you dedicated enterprise Lights-Out (iLO 5) hardware management, allowing you to monitor temperatures, pull server health logs, and handle remote console/virtual media mounting independently of Proxmox.

Ref: fd-4f2fe53e
